# algosec_url_category (Data Source)

Look up one Panorama URL-category override by exact name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "algosec_url_category" "example" {
  name = "tf-example-services"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Exact category name.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Category name.
- `urls` (Map of Set of String) URL strings mapped to sets of individual IP addresses.
